title: Ofada Rice with Ayamase
description: Ofada Rice with Ayamase is a Nigeria classic prepared with brown rice, yellow onion, green bell pepper, scotch bonnet pepper. A measured home-style version, with ingredients assigned to the cooking steps where they are used. Brown rice substitutes for unavailable Nigerian ofada rice. The ayamase sauce is adapted with green pepper and available spices.

steps.instruction: Spread the rice evenly into the flavorful liquid. Cook uncovered or partly covered for about 26 minutes until the liquid is absorbed; do not over-stir.
Chop the vegetables as needed. Sauté the listed ingredients over medium heat, stirring, for about 12 minutes until softened and aromatic.
Combine the remaining ingredients, cover partly and stew gently for about 22 minutes until the flavors meld and everything is tender.
Assemble the cooled components with the listed fillings or toppings. Refrigerate briefly if needed to set the layers.
